title: The Golden Sex Podcast
author: Diane Carty
description: What if your most liberated, confident, playful chapter…hasn't happened yet? Welcome to The Golden Sex Podcast, the show for women and men over 50 who know that life isn't winding down, it's just heating up. I'm your host, Diane Marie Carty. If you've ever wondered whether passion, desire, intimacy, confidence, or great sex has an expiration date, you're in the right place. Because somewhere along the way, society tells us that menopause, divorce, retirement, or after a certain birthday - the fun part's over. But I'm here to tell you that's complete nonsense. The best sex of my life happened after 65. After my divorce, I spent nearly 14 years celibate. 14 years. Then one unexpected introduction at a wedding changed everything. I met an incredible man in his 80s, and together we've created the most playful, passionate, joyful, sexy relationship of my life. What I've discovered in this stage comes with something younger people often don't have, and that's freedom. No worries about building a family. No pressure to impress. No pretending to be someone you're not. Just honesty, connection, laughter, and yes, really hot sex. We'll tackle the realities of menopause, libido, dating after divorce, after loss, widow and widower's fire, sexual wellness, relationships, communication, and, yes, toys, fantasies, and pleasure!
